wait.text:
Waiting on you
Nothing right now: every board on this page is decided.

sNew.text: How to read this canvas: every screen is drawn as it would ship, from the app’s own parts. New parts aren’t marked; to see them, open an artboard’s Tweaks and turn on “Show what’s new”. Not reproducible here: the basemap tiles and the pencil grain.

n1.text: 1 · The add tag: city, TYPE, NEW stamp, star and visited

n3.text: 3 · Section header, the count and Go to

s1.text: Decided (you): the city is the tag’s routing line, with no rule under it, on every add/edit tag; the CITY row is gone. Tap the city to change it. The real town stays in the address line.

s1b.text: A new city: the deep-orange NEW stamp (picked by you) sits inside the city dropdown, between the name and its chevron, and marks a city that ADD will make; cancel makes nothing.

s2.text: The open TYPE list is a NEW custom menu on the one dropdown spec: natural width, dividers edge to edge, content on one left edge, the check at the right, opening just under its trigger. We think icons help.

s2b.text: Visited works exactly as shipped (owner: "do not tuch"): at add, the tag’s own Visited segment, and its stamp, unchanged. Star likewise: the segment, plus the band.

sA.text: The menu opens straight onto your cities or your plans. The other kind is a quiet last row, a plain row like the others: “Plans 3 ›” in Places, “Places 202 ›” in Plans. The title is just the city or plan.

sCount.text: The count, decided (owner): a quiet tally, a smaller grey figure after the name, no brackets. Used everywhere: list title, section headers, Go to, the map badges, Plans. Cluster discs keep the number inside.

s3.text: Going to a city only moves the map: nothing hides, the list keeps everything. Show/hide sits on the section heading (the eye). Going to a hidden city shows it again.

s3b.text: Open: the list title once it holds every city. We think "All places (202)"; a hidden city reads greyed in go-to lists.

sPlans.text: Plans: the title stays the plan name (the plan picker); Go to sits beside it, smaller, and lists Whole plan, then the plan’s cities in stop order, then your other cities. It moves the map only. A hidden city with stops still lists.

sRej.text: Rejected (owner, 2026-10-16): "no this is far too complex." Search 1 (worldwide, each result says where) and Search 3 (near the map view) remain.

sOpt.text: Option 1 (we think): two actions that never look alike. The title picks what you look at (all places or a plan); a section heading takes you somewhere inside it (a city, or a plan’s leg). Option 2, one long menu for both, is in jam.md, not drawn: it blurs exactly that line.
